notes.title: Monster Girl Jungle Introduction
notes.content:
It’s been a few days—hope you’re all doing great and still enjoying My Life in a Monster Girl Paradise!

First off, huge thanks to everyone who's supported the project by buying the game. It seriously means a lot and keeps me motivated to make more games and bring fun experiences to all of you.

If you’re enjoying the full release and it’s hit your fancy, I’d really appreciate it if you left a review and maybe share it around if you know someone who would like a this type of game!

Now, about what’s next—I want to give you all a little introduction to my next project.
[list]
[*] Note:Some part of the decorations are outdated since i already updated a lot of aspecto of the next game, I will probably share some images about it soon in the game page.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3557720/Monster_Girl_Jungle/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44813025/c49f44fe5ae7d1be5734ce02d52381e7132890c7.png[/img]
Explore the jungle, meet its intriguing inhabitants, manage your hunger to stay safe, and form a unique bond with a playful monster girl.
[list]
[*] It’s basically a visual novel with some light sandbox elements and simple stat management to give players a bit more interaction alongside the story.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44813025/e147b5776a176b0e95e2e83321908183a9796cbc.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Zelra is a lamia girl with a twisted personality. She often uses hypnosis to weaken her prey, luring them into a state of bliss as her long snake tail slowly coils around them.
[*] ?
[*] ?
[*] ?
[/list]
[list]
[*] (There are 4 monster girls planned in total, but right now only one is ready.)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44813025/90b2858c74e538a02cb6a90636e086f3a486a5a9.png[/img]
A monster girl delights in using her unique quirks to captivate the main protagonist, like Zelra, who often relies on hypnosis to gain the upper hand.
[list]
[*] Each girl will have her own distinct "kinks" and scenarios to keep things fresh and varied. For example, Zelra features hypnosis and vore content. (Don’t worry—if vore’s not your thing, the game gives you the option to skip that kind of content!)
[/list]
Note:
[list]
[*] The game demo is already available to try out! Just a heads-up—I recommend lowering the volume a bit before playing, as some sounds can come through pretty loud depending on whether you're using speakers or headphones.
[*] This will be more balanced in the full release, which will also come with an updated demo featuring improved writing—especially in the player's background story.
[/list]

notes.title: Succubus Challenge Launch
notes.content:
Hi everybody, I just want to share that recently I launched a small project, which is already complete and released.

This is a small game. I made it to learn and test the engine, which I will use for my future works.

If you would like to try it out, the game has a free demo.

The game is not perfect, but I hope you will find it enjoyable.

Here is the description of the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3277560/Succubus_Challenge
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733699/6fad6a7bda2e433e892c29de053205af31fee910.png[/img]
Do you want a more difficult fight or an easier one? You have the option to choose the difficulty level for each battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733699/f7e1574458bbe9d81ab2794ac6be625c7904dda4.png[/img]
In each turn, your succubus opponent will carry out a sexual attack on you; to win, you must fight and beat the demon by using the unholy trinity of headpat, handhold, and kissing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733699/841532ccfc59edb9fc2241f9ca268701f3cf997d.png[/img]
Perhaps you need a little additional assistance before the battle? Interact with the succubus girl and gain a buff that will greatly help you during the fight.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733699/eaed3ec1343ba714de3300722c7ed25e6ca6b14f.png[/img]
After a victory, you will be granted a score, which is needed for content and unlocking progression; the more you win, the more sexual scenes you can see.

notes.title: My Life In A Monster Girl Paradise Demo Release + Important News
notes.content:
[b]Build Related News:[/b]
Hello everbody Some of you may have noticed that the game demo was removed. The reason for this is because I wanted to rework the old demo to be more up-to-date.
[b] What are the differences? [/b]
The game's latest version was used as a base for the demo.
The players were able to enjoy the full beach area, but the kitchen/bath-related events were removed and the cave area as well.
Everything else—bug fixes, UI-road effect, and other small extras that improved the gameplay—stayed.
The demo playtime should be around 1-2 hours long. ( depends on the person. )
[b]Other News:[/b]
The game and the Steam pages received a lot of updates these days.
Links were added—people can join my Discord server, follow me on Twitter, etc.
New Capsules
New Trailer, which shows the game updated state, giving a better view for people of what kind of game this is.
New Page Design - Kinks and character designs are listed.
[b]Bad News[/b]
I didn't want to change the game price originally, but a lot of bad things have happened since the start of the year; one of them is not having a tax treaty and some other reasons.
The pricing change is not going to be big, but I will keep it at a reasonable price for the playtime and contents.
[b]Good News [/b]
If everything goes well, I'm going to have a nice surprise in the next month for people. (Next Area Related)
Paid version game time goes between 2-5 hours but of course its depends on the person. (for people if they considering buying the game)

notes.title: My Life In A Monster Girl Paradise 0.9A Fix
notes.content:
Bug fix and improvement package for the dating system.
All you need to do is rest for a day, and all switches related to dating will reset from now on.
Details bellow:
Some characters do not show up during the date, so you can't proceed with it. It is fixed. The cause was more likely to happen because the invite failed before and the value did not reset, so once the invite succeeded, it was still in the state of failing.
I added extra switches to the reset system, which means even if you are not coming to the date, the girl will reset without you needing to do anything.
